name: Consolidated Communications / Fidium Fiber
notes: Internet-category dossier for Consolidated/Fidium (same company as the phone-landline dossier consolidated-communications-now-branded-fidium-i-c73db6). Researched 2026-10-10 from public consolidated.com support pages and the public One-Time Payment page (pay.consolidated.com; read only, nothing entered). Billing portals depend on location: MyCCI.net (CA, IA, MN, ND, TX, parts of IL/PA) and MyCCIAccount.com (most of ME/NH/VT) offer bills, payments, AutoPay and settings; the Online Bill Pay Portal (AL, CO, FL, GA, KS, MA, MO, NY, OK, parts of IL/ME/NH/PA/VT) offers bills and payments only. The one-time payment page asks for the billing account number, a verification method (mobile phone or email on the account), the 4-digit Customer PIN and a 6-digit verification code - PIN and code lookups are not expressible, so the guest form keeps account number plus phone as an approximation. Accepted: electronic check and Visa/Mastercard/Discover; phone payments at 1.844.968.7224 carry a convenience fee (amount unpublished); online fees not stated (none charged). AutoPay enroll/disable in the portal (draft day in the confirmation email; family timing kept). Paperless: opt out of paper in the portal. Internet bills in advance. Payment plans only by phone after a nonpayment disconnect. Cancel by phone with no penalty; a prepaid return label arrives in 5-7 days and equipment is due back within 30 days (ship only; do not drop at offices). Sign-in identifier not described (family default kept). Late charge amount not published.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans aren't set up online. If your service was disconnected for nonpayment, call 1.844.968.7224 to arrange a payment plan and reinstatement.

cancel_service.note: Call 1.844.968.7224 to cancel or change service; there's no penalty. A prepaid return label is mailed to you, and equipment is due back within 30 days.

notes: Payments made by phone carry a convenience fee.
A late charge applies if a statement isn't paid by its due date.

help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: Pay in your online billing portal, make a one-time payment without signing in, call 1.844.968.7224 (a convenience fee applies to phone payments), mail a check or money order to the address on your statement with your account number, or pay through your bank's bill pay using Consolidated or Fidium as the biller. Texas customers can also pay cash at Fidelity Express.

Online payments accept an electronic check or a Visa, Mastercard or Discover card. For a one-time payment, have your billing account number and 4-digit Customer PIN ready; a 6-digit verification code is sent to the mobile phone or email on your account.

Your portal depends on where you live: MyCCI.net and MyCCIAccount.com offer bills, payments, AutoPay and settings, while the Online Bill Pay Portal offers bills and payments only. Internet is billed in advance, so a first bill can include a partial month plus the next full month.

help.title: Canceling service and returning equipment
paragraphs: You can change or cancel your plan any time with no penalty by calling 1.844.968.7224. The agent lists the equipment to return, such as your WiFi gateway, and a prepaid return label arrives by mail in about 5 to 7 days.
Ship your equipment within 30 days of cancelling to avoid unreturned equipment fees. Send it only to the address on the label; don't drop it off at an office.

extra.intent: A Fidium customer wants to make a one-time payment without signing in. Find which PIN they need to have ready and how many digits it has. Do not make a payment.

solution.text: Have your billing account number and your 4-digit Customer PIN ready.
